title: Answer price questions before they are asked
what_to_do: Put the PKR price (stitched/unstitched) in the caption, first frame or a pinned comment of new product posts, and set a DM/WhatsApp quick reply with the current price list.
why_it_matters: 63 comments (7.8% of 809 clustered comments) fall in discovered cluster(s) #3 named 'Price / cost' (name agreement 79%).
limitations_json: ["Associational, not causal: campaigns, budgets and seasons are confounded with content and timing.", "Comments are a retained sample of visible threads, not every comment a post received.", "Clusters were discovered without labels; their names come from a rule-based reference labeller (agreement shown)."]
test_plan: For 2 weeks, alternate comparable product posts with and without the price in the caption. Compare the share of comments in the price cluster (expect lower) and purchase-inquiry comments (expect equal or higher).
